tools.name: spacebring_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (spaces) of the network, with their id, title, timezone and currency. Good first call: other tools filter by location id. GET /locations/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id: address, business address, timezone, currency and opening schedule. GET /locations/v1/{locationId}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_memberships
tools.description: List members and memberships with status, type, role, company, location and credits. Filter by status, location, company, user or email. GET /community/memberships/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_membership
tools.description: Get one membership by id: user, company, status, role, credits, day passes, notes and subscription link. GET /community/memberships/v1/{id}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (teams and organisations) with their title, types and location. GET /community/companies/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_events
tools.description: List events with their title, start and end, location, price, attendee count and visibility. Filter by location and date range. GET /events/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: description, dates, venue, price, tickets, attendees (when shown) and hosts. GET /events/v1/{id}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_resources
tools.description: List bookable resources (desks, offices, meeting rooms and similar) with their type and location. GET /resources/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings with their resource, user, status, start and end, filtered by location, resource, user, status and date range. GET /resources/bookings/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_booking
tools.description: Get one resource booking by id: resource, user, status, start, end and price. GET /resources/bookings/v1/{bookingId}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their status, number, issue date and customer. Filter by status, location, customer, company, membership and issue date. GET /billing/invoices/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: status, line items, amounts, taxes, dates and payments. GET /billing/invoices/v1/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions with their status, plan, customer and location. Filter by status, customer, plan and creation date. GET /subscriptions/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id: plan, items, status, billing period and customer. GET /subscriptions/v1/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: spacebring_list_plans
tools.description: List membership and rental plans with their price, period and location. GET /plans/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_shop_orders
tools.description: List shop orders with their status, customer, product and creation date. Filter by location, status, customer, user and product. GET /shop/orders/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_check_ins
tools.description: List member check-ins and check-outs with the user, location, type, status and time. GET /check_ins/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_visits
tools.description: List visitor visits with the host, the visitor, the location, the status and the visit time. GET /visitors/visits/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_list_support_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets with their number, type, status, requester and assignee. Filter by location, requester membership or company, and assignee. GET /support/tickets/v1.

tools.name: spacebring_get_support_ticket
tools.description: Get one support ticket by id: number, type, status, description, requester, assignee and dates. GET /support/tickets/v1/{id}.

tools.name: spacebring_create_support_ticket_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a text comment to a support ticket. The comment is visible to the people who can see the ticket. POST /support/tickets/v1/comment.

tools.name: spacebring_set_support_ticket_status
tools.description: WRITE: set the status of a support ticket to new, inProgress, solved or closed. Setting the same status again changes nothing. PUT /support/tickets/v1/{id}/status.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spacebring_list_memberships, spacebring_get_event, spacebring_list_invoices, spacebring_list_support_tickets, spacebring_get_support_ticket · Public sink: spacebring_list_memberships, spacebring_create_support_ticket_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spacebring_list_memberships, spacebring_get_event, spacebring_list_invoices, spacebring_list_support_tickets, spacebring_get_support_ticket · Public sink: spacebring_list_memberships, spacebring_create_support_ticket_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
